document: UI-02 implementation tickets (PRD §32, WP-00 exit artifact)

conventions.order: Tickets are in priority order inside each work package.
conventions.size: S = under an hour for one agent, M = one to three hours, L = more
conventions.files: Existing paths to change, checked against the file system when this file was built.
conventions.newFiles: Paths to create; none existed when this file was built.
conventions.routes: How many register routes the ticket covers; routePatterns lists them when there are twelve or fewer. The register's tickets field is the reverse index.
conventions.acceptance: The UI02 cases of PRD §31 the ticket closes or moves; the gap analysis lists every case.

tickets.title: Shell geometry under version 2: 208/64px sidebar, 64/60/56px header, 32px breadcrumbs, 40px project tabs
tickets.notes: Version 1 has --nesto-sidebar-width 240px / 72px and --nesto-topbar-height 64px / 56px (styles/tokens.css:173-176); there is no 60px tablet step and no token for the breadcrumb or tab row. Override the existing names under :root[data-ds="2"] and give any new name a version-1 default that reproduces today's height. globals.css:239 sums --nesto-shell-header-h + breadcrumb-h + tabs-h into --nesto-sticky-stack: the ruler, the table head and every sticky page layer read it, so change the inputs, never the sum. tests/unit/a11y/theme-drift.test.ts checks every number in config/theme.ts against the CSS. The topbar writes h-14 md:h-16 as classes (components/layout/topbar.tsx:54); the compact-density rule in tokens-v2.css deliberately skips [data-shell-region].

tickets.title: Sidebar behaviour: gold edge rule on the active item, neutral hover, rail tooltips, no hover auto-expand
tickets.notes: aria-current and rail accessible names already exist (docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md, Shell rows). The sidebar state is a cookie read on the server (lib/layout/sidebar-state.ts) plus components/layout/user-scoped-state.ts: do not add a second store (§7.1). Three shells draw three navigations; the platform and group shells do not use sidebar-nav.tsx.

tickets.title: Sticky geometry: banners and page toolbars join the measured stack; table heads and anchors read it
tickets.notes: StickyStack (components/ui/sticky.tsx) already measures a page's own header, sub-header and tabs below --nesto-sticky-top-offset. --nesto-banner-height is a fixed 2.8125rem (globals.css:386), not measured. Table heads stick inside their own scroll region, never to the page (components/ui/table.tsx header comment), so a page-level sticky table head is new behaviour: decide per template before changing it. Z-order: version 1 has topbar 30 under sidebar 40 (tokens.css:181-189) while §7.3 wants sidebar 20 under shell 30.

tickets.title: Back restores the scroll anchor of a list or record (filters already restore from the URL)
tickets.notes: Conflict with today's rule: ScrollToTop sets history.scrollRestoration = "manual" and scrolls to the top on every pathname change, by design. Keep that for forward navigation and restore only on a history traversal, by record or section anchor plus offset, never by percentage. The record history lives in sessionStorage (HISTORY_KEY nesto-record-navigation-v1, at most 75 entries). Restoration must recheck permission: a revoked record restores nothing. The history guard of AUD-03 (lib/unsaved/history-guard.ts) owns popstate; go through it.

tickets.title: One page-header and toolbar pattern for module, record and settings pages
tickets.notes: Four components draw an h1 block today: PageHeader (49 routes), ModulePage (140), RecordHeader and RecordContextHeader (131), SettingsPageHeader (17). Unify the markup under them rather than adding a fifth. ModulePage is an async Server Component that reads translations; RecordHeader renders the breadcrumbs itself, which the sticky navigation bar also shows.

tickets.title: Page contract registry: template, scroll region, ruler policy per route, checked against the route register
tickets.notes: The register was built by a scratch script; check it in as scripts/ui/route-register.ts beside scripts/navigation/route-inventory.ts, with a test that fails when an app/**/page.tsx has no entry (the NAV-01 inventory does the same for loading boundaries). The judged fields (template, rulerPolicy, v2Status) must survive a regeneration: keep them in the script's decision table, not only in the JSON.

tickets.title: Sign-in, recovery, invitation and system pages on the focused form layout
tickets.notes: Not to be changed: app/(public)/login/quick-login.tsx, lib/actions/quick-login.ts, lib/auth/quick-login.ts and the five quick-login lines in app/(public)/login/page.tsx. The sign-in panel mounts no data-app-shell, so it keeps its serif display type under version 2 by design (tokens-v2.css, "Display type"). No loading.tsx exists for the public, offline, device-unavailable and maintenance pages; they render synchronously. Recovery pages must not disclose whether an account exists (§7.5).

tickets.title: Platform Admin and Group shells: skip link, live announcer, loading boundaries, same header rules
tickets.notes: docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md records it open: no skip link and no LiveAnnouncer in the platform layout. None of the 8 /group routes has a loading.tsx, and they fall back to the root app/error.tsx. Both layouts were edited in the foundation stage (data-app-shell).

tickets.title: Mobile project tabs and context tabs: one scrollable row with a labelled More control
tickets.notes: The Sticky Navigation PRD (eaa60ed4) already built context tabs with More; this is the version-2 height (40px) and the overflow affordance. Project routes show Overview, Planning, Units, Sales, Tasks, Calendar first (§7); only authorised destinations appear.

tickets.title: Dialog, Drawer and BottomSheet under version 2: 480-640px drawer, full-width small screens, 180-220ms, no stacked dialogs
tickets.notes: The right drawer is max-w-[340px] sm:max-w-[480px] (components/ui/drawer.tsx:35): 480px is the floor of §14.2, not the default. Dirty-close protection is in guarded-root.tsx (AUD-03) and must be kept: closing goes through DialogClose or useDialogClose, never setOpen(false). The ruler already yields to a blocking dialog (components/ui/scroll-ruler.tsx:63-64). Dialog has three phone layouts (fullscreen, sheet, centred) chosen by class; every size is a literal.

tickets.title: Menus, popovers and select lists: 8px gap, collision handling, bounded height, focus ring
tickets.notes: Two selects exist on purpose: Select (Radix, 3 routes) and FormSelect (native, 238 routes). All popups share .nesto-popup-glass; version 2 already gives it the 12px overlay radius. Under touch every popup becomes a slab of glass (globals.css:870).

tickets.title: Tooltip timing: 400ms open, 100ms close, everywhere
tickets.notes: IconButton opens at 400ms (TOOLTIP_OPEN_MS) through its own provider; AppShell wraps the app in TooltipProvider delayDuration={200}. Changing the shell's delay changes version 1: make the delay follow the design-system version.

tickets.title: Confirmation quality: object and consequence in the copy, safer default focus, typed confirmation for organisation deletion
tickets.notes: 113 routes reach ConfirmDialog. safeInitialFocus already skips a danger control (AUD-11). No typed confirmation exists anywhere. Copy lives in per-module dictionaries (lib/i18n/modules/*): an audit of "Are you sure" strings is a sweep over those, in both languages.

tickets.title: Toasts: about six seconds, pause on hover and focus, at most three, never over a footer action
tickets.notes: Duration is 5000ms (components/ui/toast.tsx:63); Radix pauses on hover and focus already. There is no cap on the stack. Polite and assertive are already split by tone (AUD-11). The viewport sits at --nesto-bottom-reserve, the phone's bottom bar.

tickets.title: State components: first load, refresh, empty, no matches, no permission, module unavailable, partial failure, offline
tickets.notes: EmptyState and NoResultsState are one file; 229 routes reach it and 82 write an empty line inline. Skeletons live in four places (ui/skeleton, ui/loading-state, layout/page-skeletons, modules/section-skeletons) plus app/admin/_dashboard/list-skeleton.tsx. Connectivity and sync status already render in the app shell (components/offline/offline-status.tsx, MOB-09) and there is a separate offline shell (app/(offline)); the platform and group shells have neither.

tickets.title: Search, Notifications and Account panels at 680 / 400 / 320px with the version-2 parts
tickets.notes: UI-01 owns the behaviour; only the presentation changes. The panels are lazy chunks registered in lib/navigation/panel-host.ts (one overlay at a time). The account panel and the bell were edited in the foundation stage. components/layout/user-menu.tsx is the pre-UI-01 menu and no file imports it any more; theme-toggle.tsx is still imported by the phone bottom bar, the platform shell and the public site header.

tickets.title: Session expiry warning and reauthentication prompt
tickets.notes: Missing today (docs/ui/UI-01-universal-header-gap-analysis.md, §12.2 row). The eight-hour maximum is server policy (docs/session-security.md); the warning must not extend it. Cross-tab logout already uses BroadcastChannel in session-lifecycle.tsx.

tickets.title: Entity preview popover with a whitelisted preview read
tickets.notes: Nothing like it exists. PersonLink (215 routes) is a plain link. The read is new backend work: a typed entity reference in, whitelisted fields out, no HR or payroll field (§15). It needs a row in the security sweep (pnpm verify:authorization) so it does not add a finding. P1 at most; ship the rest of OVERLAYS without it.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: DataTable anatomy under version 2: result count, toolbar, chips, sticky header, totals, pagination at 25/50/100
tickets.notes: 128 routes reach DataTable and 90 ListToolbar; none of the files in components/data carries a ds2: class yet. Sorting, filters and paging are server-side and live in the URL (lib/tables/list-url.ts); every list has a row in docs/tables/list-manifest.md and tests/unit/tables/list-manifest.test.ts fails on a listId without one. The manifest records lists with no id tie-breaker (for example contractors.contractor-contacts): fix those here.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Raw tables onto the Table primitive
tickets.notes: Each of these draws <table> by hand, so the density's row height, the solid sticky header and the phone stack never reach it. The HSE risk matrix (components/hse/hse-format.tsx:134) is a real grid, not a list: keep it a table, restyle it with tokens. Print pages keep their own table.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Row selection on desktop: page-only header checkbox, count, selection bar
tickets.notes: Selection exists as a phone mode only (MOB-03 §30-§33): tap Select, tick cards, act. Any query change clears it (selectionSurvivesQueryChange). Table already has a `selected` row state under version 2. Checkbox has no indeterminate state.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Column controls: resize and pin with keyboard alternatives, beside the existing show/hide
tickets.notes: Show/hide exists per listId and is stored in localStorage under the identity and workspace (lib/tables/preferences.ts, TABLE_PREFERENCES_VERSION); widths and pins are new fields, so bump the version and migrate. Table is a semantic table inside a horizontal scroll region: a pinned column needs a solid background and position: sticky inside that region.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Saved views: model, API and SavedViewSelector
tickets.notes: Backend gap. Only the shape exists: SavedViewShape and toSavedView in lib/data/query-state.ts (MOB-03 §84), with no storage. Needs a migration: never `prisma migrate dev`; diff into a throwaway database and `migrate deploy`. The port-3000 database has none of this branch's migrations, so every read of the new table must be behind the version-2 flag or tolerate its absence. Validate the filter AST per list against the list manifest; a shared view is a configuration, never a grant.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: All-matching selection token, bulk preview and bulk execution with per-item outcomes
tickets.notes: Backend gap. Today's bulk actions take explicit ids and the server authorises each record. Project structure has its own bulk create and copy dialogs (components/project-structure/bulk-dialogs.tsx) with a check step: the closest thing to an eligibility preview. No module has a bulk approval capability, and §18.2 says the table must not add one. Reuse the job ledger (lib/core/jobs) for long runs.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Totals and export: page or all-filtered label, chosen columns, export jobs with status
tickets.notes: One exporter already exists (AUD-08 §7): the list's own query, every match, typed cells, formula guarding in lib/utils/csv.ts, and a refusal with a sentence past the row, byte or time cap. It is synchronous by decision and never answers a partial file. Jobs with Queued/Preparing/Ready/Failed/Expired are new: they need storage for the file and an expiry. Seven per-module export links are near copies of one another; fold them onto export-control.tsx. An export's columns are a documented schema, independent of the screen (exporter.ts): "explicitly chosen columns" changes that contract.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Form kit under version 2: label, control, help, error; 720-880px width; required convention; error summary
tickets.notes: Two form kits. RecordForm with form-contract.tsx (220 routes; error summary, focus, AUD-09) and components/engineering/form-kit.tsx (FormDialog, FormFields, ReasonDialog, useRequestEditor), which 31 files import, 22 of them outside Engineering and Contractors (workforce, platform, people, organization, HR, HSE), although it lives under engineering. Give both one field anatomy; do not merge their save lifecycles. Checkbox, Radio and Switch carry no ds2: class and no density. Button has a `loading` state that keeps its width and focus under version 2; RecordForm and the form kit still disable their submit button while a save runs, so move them onto it. Every editor registers with the unsaved-work coordinator (docs/unsaved-work.md): keep named inputs, because dirtiness is what the form would submit. tests/architecture/form-save-kind.test.ts guards the save kinds.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Raw fields onto Input, FormSelect and Textarea
tickets.notes: A hand-drawn <input>, <select> or <textarea> misses the control border (AUD-11 raised it to 3:1), the density height and the 44px touch height. Hidden, checkbox, radio, file and range inputs are not counted. The 3D editor and viewer files belong to WP05-20 and keep their tool layout.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: One line-item editor for invoices, quotes, orders and stock documents
tickets.notes: Four line editors exist (finance ×2, procurement, inventory). Each names its rows' inputs so the unsaved-work snapshot sees them, and each already offers a local Undo for a removed draft line. Totals are previews until the server answers (AUD-01, docs/finance-registers.md): keep the authoritative total from the service.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Date, date-time and date-range controls with explicit time zone and blocked invalid ranges
tickets.notes: Dates are native inputs today. The company-day rule (PRD #51) and date-only helpers already exist in two copies (finance/local-date.ts, hr/local-day.ts). Postgres runs in Europe/Tirane: raw SQL must use now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'. tests/architecture/date-number-format.test.ts guards formatting.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Entity picker and dependent fields: scoped search, states, an explicit notice when a dependent value is cleared
tickets.notes: RelationSelector is the only component that implements nearly every state of §9, and one form (the sales opportunity form, two routes) uses it; pickers elsewhere are FormSelect with a preloaded list. Standalone projects (nullable Project.companyId) and name-only company creation must stay possible (§13.4).

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Mutation envelope: request id, retryability, current version; idempotency key and status lookup after a timeout
tickets.notes: Backend gap in part. The unknown outcome already exists on the client (AUD-03: "not saved" versus "unknown", no automatic retry of a create). Idempotency keys exist only for document uploads, approval decisions and jobs. An expected or base version appears in about a hundred files, and 29 models carry a version column; a mutation on any other model is last-write-wins. A request id exists in the logger (lib/core/observability/request-context.ts) but is not returned in every error body.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Inline editing pattern with validation, commit, cancel and conflict
tickets.notes: No shared inline-edit pattern exists. The conflict review of AUD-02 (Task.version, mutateTask, docs/task-mutations.md) is the model to follow. Financial, posting and approval transitions are never cell edits (§12.5). P1 at most: build it for one list (task title or due date) before any other.

tickets.wp: WP-03 tables, filters, forms, saved views
tickets.title: Reference implementations: Finance invoices list and form, Projects directory, Admin Users
tickets.notes: The Projects page lost its filters, sort and list view by the user's own decision (Projects grid PRD, df5e74b8): it is search plus a card grid, so its reference is the card family, not the table. Admin Users filters are a hand-drawn form (components/platform/organization-filters.tsx) outside ListToolbar. The invoice detail page draws one raw table and four .nesto-card sections.

tickets.title: UiPreferences per user: model, GET and PATCH /api/me/ui-preferences with a version
tickets.notes: Backend gap. Theme, density, ruler and sidebar are four browser cookies (nesto.theme, nesto.density, nesto.ruler, the sidebar cookie), so a second person on the same browser inherits them: UI02-11 fails as written. No model holds a UI preference. Additive migration; the port-3000 database will not have the table, so the read must fall back to the cookies. The patch never accepts a user id (§27).

tickets.title: Preference controls save to the server, mirror to cookies for first paint, clear on sign-out and user change, sync across tabs
tickets.notes: The server decides the version, density and ruler per request from cookies (lib/layout/design-server.ts), which is what keeps the first paint free of a flash: keep the cookies as the mirror and the row as the truth. A failed save must stay visible and retryable (§27.2). The version cookie nesto.ds is a development switch, not a preference, and stays out of the model.

tickets.title: Persistence order for lists: URL, saved view, personal default, product default; table preferences join it
tickets.notes: Column visibility and page size are per-list localStorage entries keyed by identity and workspace. Local mirrors may hold appearance only (§27.2): a column list is fine, a filter value is not.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Metric contract and MetricStrip for every module KPI grid
tickets.notes: MetricStrip exists and only the catalog renders it. Other figure components do the same job: dashboard KpiCard, six *-kpis.tsx grids, MetricGrid and Metric in engineering-ui.tsx, and 43 page and component files that define a local Stat, Figure, Metric, Panel, Row or AttentionPanel function. Two registries already describe metrics: config/kpis.ts (permission and workspace per dashboard KPI) and lib/core/reporting/metric.registry.ts (value type, aggregation, currency behaviour, date field, snapshot or flow, PRD #27). Extend the second; freshness and drilldown are the fields it lacks. AUD-01 fixed the finance figures (docs/finance-registers.md): a null balance must stay distinct from zero and currencies are never summed across companies.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Project overview on the canonical structure: summary metrics, image and attention, financials, milestones, activity
tickets.notes: The ruler is already wired here. The page is 600 lines with eight .nesto-card sections, hover motion on its render tiles and its own shadows; the phone has a separate component. Section numbers come from the visible order, ids stay stable (§17.2). View in 3D opens the published viewer only (app/(project-viewer)); no upload control for company users.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Company dashboard and its widgets: three to five metrics, role sections, honest bars
tickets.notes: Ruler wired and the widgets restyled in the foundation stage. Role composition already comes from a registry (config/dashboards.ts, config/widgets.ts), which is what §11.3 asks for. The same route renders the group workspace's dashboard (GroupBanner, group-hero.tsx). The Pending Approvals card is an accent patch in version 1 and a plain card in version 2 through .nesto-on-accent.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Module overview template with the ruler: Finance, HR, HSE, Inventory, Procurement, QA/QC, Sales, Contracts, Clients, Tasks, Documents, Engineering, Team, Organization and the project module dashboards
tickets.notes: Six pages each define their own AttentionPanel function (sales, contracts, qaqc, procurement, inventory, hr) and most define a local Row or Stat. ModuleOverview exists and no route imports it. Wiring the ruler is three lines per page (PageSections, PageSection, PageSectionLinks) once the page has three real sections; a section the reader may not see is not registered (§17.1).

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Group overview and Personal Work pages
tickets.notes: app/group/page.tsx is 56 lines of links in four .nesto-card blocks with no shared primitive and no metric; a group overview needs a demo person who can open /group (the capture tool signs in as Olivia Owner, who lands in the company shell). My Day has a dark hero card on its own tokens (--nesto-hero).

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Card families: project, document, action, person, shortcut and comparison cards on Card and CardLink
tickets.notes: Card and CardLink exist with the selected and navigable states. 22 files import Card and only the catalog imports CardLink, while 324 routes reach the .nesto-card CSS class directly. The project card has hover motion and literal pixel text. A card with a menu or a checkbox must be an article with a separate primary link, never a button inside an anchor (§11.2). There is no document card: Documents is a table everywhere.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Report template: filters, as-of time, sections with the ruler, generate and export
tickets.notes: The report pages each have their own filter form and its own Figure or Bars function; none shows an as-of time. They are synchronous server renders: no report needs a generation job today, so §21's job state is not applicable until one does.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Chart conventions: title, unit, period, scope, table alternative, series palette with one gold focal series
tickets.notes: The five chart components are already non-interactive with text alternatives (role=img with values, figure plus list, progressbar) and survive forced colours (AUD-11). Only 2 routes import Donut, MiniBars or ProgressBar; most bars in the product are divs drawn in the page. The palette is one file. A unit test of the AUD-11 palette exists in tests/unit/a11y.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Print: one print stylesheet that removes the shell and the ruler, repeats table headers and keeps totals with their context
tickets.notes: There is no global @media print rule. The meeting print page carries its own in a <style> block; the daily-log print page has none. Create styles/print.css before anything imports it: an @import of a missing file took both dev servers down for seven minutes. The ruler is fixed-position and must be hidden in print; scroll-ruler.tsx already has a print: class.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Record detail template: compact header, grouped fields, secondary column, sections registered for the ruler
tickets.notes: Record pages are eligible for the ruler and none is wired. Two detail kits exist: components/detail (EntityDetailPage, DetailSection, DetailField) and the DetailGrid most record pages import from their own module. Registering sections inside DetailSection would wire every page that uses it; a page with fewer than three sections simply shows no ruler. The module tickets of WP-05 move their record pages onto this.

tickets.wp: WP-04 overview, cards, metrics, reports, print
tickets.title: Platform Admin overview: finish the leftovers of the foundation stage
tickets.notes: Ruler wired and restyled yesterday. sections.tsx still has two literal pixel sizes, two gold fills and seven .nesto-card blocks without a version-2 answer; its storage, modules and 3D figures are paragraphs, not MetricStrip cells.

tickets.title: Documents: explorer list and grid, preview chrome, upload tray, version detail
tickets.notes: Documents is a flat directory with sections (All, Recent, Archived), no folder tree, no grid view and no drag-and-drop move: §19.1's tree requirements are not applicable until a folder model exists. Upload states, idempotent upload intents and versions exist (docs/document-lifecycle.md, tests/e2e/forms/aud09-uploads.spec.ts). Eight RecordDocuments components exist, one per module plus the shared one. The provider integration is described in docs/document-provider-integration.md: show only the states it can really report (§19.3).

tickets.title: Approvals Center and the five module approval queues on one review-queue pattern
tickets.notes: Six queue implementations: the Approvals Center shell (its own tablist, filters and sticky offsets) and one ApprovalQueue per module. Decisions carry an idempotency key (components/approvals/approvals-api.ts). New approval sources plug in as providers (PRD #41): do not hard-wire a module into the shell. Bulk approval is not to be added (§18.2).

tickets.title: Tasks: lists, detail, edit with conflict review, comments and mentions
tickets.notes: There is no task board: Tasks is lists by section. §20.2's board rules apply to the sales pipeline only. Claim, version and conflict review exist (AUD-02; tests/e2e/modules/task-reliability.spec.ts). CollaborationPanel serves 39 routes across modules.

tickets.title: Calendar and meetings: view controls, event cards, list fallback, meeting workspace
tickets.notes: The calendar shell draws its own tablist and reads the sticky offsets directly. Drag move and resize exist on the week grid with the event form as the keyboard alternative (docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md). The calendar has its own phone hook (components/calendar/use-is-phone.ts) beside components/layout/use-phone.ts and components/ui/use-breakpoint.ts. Events come from a provider registry (PRD #39).

tickets.title: Planning timeline and milestones
tickets.notes: planning-shell.tsx and planning-timeline.tsx carry the most hand-drawn markup outside the 3D editor. Phase reorder already has Move up and Move down beside drag. The ruler never applies to the timeline. Milestones are a project_milestone record type inside the projects module (PRD #44).

tickets.title: Projects, structure, units and the unit page
tickets.notes: The projects page is a card grid with search only (user decision, df5e74b8). The media gallery and the cover are photo surfaces with justified neutral overlays (docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md). The unit page has its own shell (UnitShell) across eight routes. Standalone projects with no company must still render.

tickets.title: Finance: registers, record pages, forms and group reports
tickets.notes: After the reference implementation of WP03-15. AUD-01 settled the figures and the register semantics; nothing here may change a calculation. No optimistic posting (§23).

tickets.title: Procurement: requests, RFQs, quote comparison, orders, suppliers
tickets.notes: The quote comparison (/procurement/rfqs/[rfqId]/comparison) is the one place the comparison-cell family applies; awarding stays an explicit action.

tickets.title: Contracts: registers, contract record and tabs, amendments, requests
tickets.notes: Seven register sections (all, active, drafts, expiring, expired, terminated, archived) are the same list under different filters. An approval decision is immutable; the record page must not offer an edit that hides it.

tickets.title: HR, People, Team and Workforce: directories, profile, restricted records
tickets.notes: The person page is the longest page in the product (626 lines) and a natural ruler page. The public internal profile and the restricted HR and payroll record must stay visibly apart (§23); employees without a login are a different thing from accounts (§22.3, E-04). Every person name is a PersonLink (tests/architecture/person-links.test.ts).

tickets.title: Inventory: stock tables, movement documents, warehouses, items
tickets.notes: 44 routes, most of them built from shared primitives only. Five stock document kinds (receipts, issues, transfers, returns, adjustments) share document-form.tsx and document-list.tsx. Quantities carry their unit; stock shown must say how fresh it is (§23).

tickets.title: HSE: registers, severity detail, capture forms, checklist execution
tickets.notes: The largest module: 58 routes of its own plus the project HSE page. hse-format.tsx draws the risk matrix as a raw table; 19 of the module's needs-work routes read that way only because they import it, so fixing that one file moves them to token-only. Severity must be icon and text, never gold (§20.4).

tickets.title: QA/QC: inspections, defects, NCRs, corrective actions, templates
tickets.notes: Built as a sibling of HSE with the same file layout (qaqc-forms, qaqc-list, qaqc-tables, record-activity, record-documents, export-link): whatever pattern HSE moves to, QA/QC moves to with it.

tickets.title: Site diary and timesheets: capture, week grid, review
tickets.notes: The timesheet week is an entry grid with its own raw inputs, not a DataTable. Offline drafts exist for field work (MOB-09, docs/mobile/offline-field-work.md): show pending sync where they do, and add no offline behaviour anywhere else (§20.4). Draft and Submit are already separate.

tickets.title: Sales and Clients: pipeline board, leads, opportunities, proposals, client profile
tickets.notes: The pipeline is the product's only board. It needs a Move to action for keyboard and touch, and a failed or denied move must return the card (§20.2). Won and Lost are forms on their own routes, which already satisfies "open the required form before committing".

tickets.title: Engineering and Contractors: registers, RFI and submittal workspaces, work packages
tickets.notes: engineering-ui.tsx holds MetricGrid, Metric, Panel, Due and EmptyNote and still has literal pixel text; 28 of the two modules' 34 routes read as needs-work only because they import it. Revision files are frozen (PRD #46). The module's form-kit.tsx is shared far beyond the module: see WP03-08.

tickets.title: Announcements, activity, notifications, search results, support and help
tickets.notes: The announcement editor is a rich-text editor drawn with ten raw buttons. An announcement is never marked read by force (§23). /favorites and /notifications are redirects. Help is checked-in guidance per module with no support route configured: show none (§7.5).

tickets.title: Organization, company and settings: access and roles, modules, integrations, numbering, devices
tickets.notes: /organization/access shows position, source and effective access per module, which is most of §22.3's inherited, direct and effective distinction; /settings/roles is a read-only list of roles. The settings index has hover motion on its rows. A module toggle must say what happens to the module's data (§22.4). Settings sections are registered in config/settings.ts.

tickets.title: Platform Admin: organizations, users, modules and entitlements, audit, projects, system
tickets.notes: 54 routes render in the platform shell; most are small pages of PageHeader plus Table. The filters are a hand-drawn form with a raw field. AdminStatusBadge is a second status badge beside modules/status-badge.tsx. Most platform dialogs are FormDialog from components/engineering/form-kit.tsx. The Admin Console work (PRD #1-#14, docs/audits/AUD-ADMIN-01.md) fixed the scoping of Manage Users and Back: keep it.

tickets.title: 3D: authoring chrome in Platform Admin and the three viewers
tickets.notes: The editor and the viewers are immersive surfaces with their own layouts and their own stylesheet (styles/project-viewer.css); the ruler never applies. The editor panels carry the most hand-drawn markup in the repository (extended-panels.tsx alone has 31 literal pixel sizes, 16 raw buttons and 6 raw fields) and docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md records components/3d/** as another session's files: confirm with the user before editing. tests/architecture/project-3d-boundaries.test.ts keeps authoring out of company bundles. The public viewer (/view/3d/[publicId]) is anonymous.

tickets.title: Group surface: companies, users, roles, account
tickets.notes: Eight routes, built from platform components (components/platform/group-*.tsx). Creating a company needs its name only; a group-only person has no company and must not be given one (§22.2). No Group Settings page exists (UI-01 analysis): not applicable.

tickets.title: Design checks in the test suite: raw colours, hand-drawn controls, duplicate primitives, click containers
tickets.notes: The scan that produced the register's handRolled column is the seed: check it in with a baseline file and let the test ratchet down, as tests/architecture does for ownership and state writes. Raw hex is justified on photo and viewer surfaces (docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md): keep an allowlist with reasons.

tickets.title: Contrast beyond the opaque pairs: disabled, alpha blends, status tints, chart series, focus surroundings
tickets.notes: tests/unit/a11y/contrast.test.ts already measures every pair of contrast-pairs.ts against tokens-v2.css laid over tokens.css in both schemes. Disabled controls are opacity-50 on the whole element, which §6.1 warns against for readable data.

tickets.title: Acceptance evidence: one row of evidence for UI02-01 to UI02-80 and the twelve journeys as end-to-end specs under version 2
tickets.notes: The suite has 128 spec files and none sets data-ds: every existing spec ran against version 1 only. The Playwright runs share the development database, so no seeding and no server restart while a suite runs; `npm run test:e2e:prod` runs against a production build, which must never be built into .next beside a dev server. The ruler's 105 functional assertions live in a scratch tool outside the repository: port them into tests/e2e/ui02/ruler.spec.ts.

tickets.title: Accessibility pass under version 2: axe on every surface, forced colours, reduced motion, 200% and 400% zoom, screen-reader notes
tickets.notes: The manual NVDA and VoiceOver gates of AUD-11 were never run (docs/a11y/surface-inventory.md); the ruler is a custom scrollbar and §8.5 forbids calling it accessible before that. Reduced motion and forced colours have global rules in globals.css already.

tickets.title: Phone and tablet pass under version 2 at 320, 390, 768 and 1024px
tickets.notes: 35 responsive specs exist for version 1 (MOB-01..11, AUD-04). The 14px table text of version 2 is wider than version 1's 13px: the foundation stage already found one grid that pushed a phone sideways (app/(nesto)/documents/page.tsx). The capture tool reports overflowX per page.

tickets.title: Performance budgets: ruler script size and frame cost, pending feedback, no layout shift on hover
tickets.notes: NAV-01..03 left a benchmark harness and a client-bundle gate; reuse them. scroll-ruler.tsx is 712 lines: the 8KB compressed budget has not been measured. No timing may be measured while another heavy job runs on this 16 GB machine.

tickets.title: Rollout and rollback: flag, version in telemetry, rollback rehearsal, the open housekeeping decisions
tickets.notes: The flag is NESTO_DESIGN_SYSTEM and scripts/verify-production-guards.ts already proves no cookie can move the version outside development. Blocker before any merge: the quick-login panel (app/(public)/login/quick-login.tsx, lib/actions/quick-login.ts, lib/auth/quick-login.ts) signs in as a seeded person with one click; §28 forbids demo identity switching in production. It is listed here to be decided by the user, not edited by an agent. Also open: the Manrope fault in version 1, and whether a changed behaviour stays in the old look. A push to main deploys and migrates production: never push unasked.

tickets.title: Public site under version 2: pin it to version 1 or verify it page by page
tickets.notes: UI-02 does not list the public site among the surfaces it applies to, but data-ds="2" is on <html>, so the version-2 colours, radii and primary button reach all ten marketing pages; only their display type is kept (tokens-v2.css, "Display type"). None of them was captured in the foundation stage. Decide: scope the version-2 rules to the signed-in shells, or accept the restyle and capture it.

tickets.title: Albanian and English for every new string; long-label checks
tickets.notes: English and Albanian are supported; German is not, so §25.2's German exercise is not applicable. The remaining Albanian translation is parked on the local branch wip/albanian-translation by the user's instruction: do not resume it. docs/ux/glossary.md fixes the nouns and verbs.
